purpose: Illustrative design concepts; fictional data, not application screenshots.
prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high fidelity desktop application screenshot, 1440x1000 landscape. A South African Capitec banking operations workspace, deliberately simple and usable. Brand: white sidebar with Capitec red/blue symbol and lowercase blue capitec wordmark, deep navy #0033A0 headings, primary blue #2F70EF, white cards on very pale blue-grey #F5F7FB, restrained red reserved for alerts, Nunito Sans style readable typography, generous but purposeful spacing, blue pill primary buttons. Sidebar groups Workspace (Overview, Transactions selected, Fraud checks, Statements), Manage (Fraud rules), Testing separate near bottom. Results table with Date, Account, Description and reference in lighter second line, Category badge, right-aligned signed Amount, subtle row chevron. Realistic fictional Amina Dlamini and Ben Mokoena, FreshMart, GadgetHub, salary, fuel purchase; ZAR decimal values. Footer says Showing 25 transactions, next page controls. Search input contains FreshMart and results correspond, totals should be modest for filtered results: instead set metric cards Transactions 12, Money in R0.00, Money out R4,215.50. No balance claims, no payments or refunds buttons, no fake live health, no technical Kafka or SQL copy. Produce one coherent full screen design, crisp readable text, no surrounding device frame.
